datasets.title: The effects of Mycophenolate treatment on the transcriptomes of patients with symptomatic carotid artery stenosis
datasets.summary: This study was conducted in order to assess the effects of the compound Mycophenolate mofetil (MMF), an inhibitor of the enzyme inosine monophosphate dehydroxygenase (IMPDH) with a strong cytostatic effect on T-cells, on the phenotype of human carotid artery stenosis in humans in vivo. This was done at the transcriptome level by comparing the gene expression profiles of carotid endarterectomy samples from patients with carotid artery stenosis (>70% diameter stenosis on angiography) that were randomly assigned to treatment with MMF 1000 mg (N=9) or Placebo (N=11), respectively. MMF or placebo was given for at least 2 weeks prior to undergoing carotid endarterectomy (CEA).
datasets.overall_design: Patients and study personnel were blinded to study group assignments. The institutional ethics committee approved the study, and informed consent was obtained prior to enrollment. This study is registered as an International Standardised Randomised Controlled Trial, number ISRCTN84092396.

datasets.title: Mitochondrial C5aR1 activity in macrophages controls IL-1β production underlying sterile inflammation
datasets._9da727: SOGEN·索臻生物科技·sogentech.com·增量更新与更多专题在群里·公众号医学僧的科研日记
datasets.summary: While serum-circulating complement destroys invading pathogens, intracellularly active complement, termed the ‘complosome’, functions as a vital orchestrator of cell-metabolic events underlying T cell effector responses. Whether intracellular complement is also non-redundant for the activity of myeloid immune cells is currently unknown. Here, we show that monocytes and macrophages constitutively express complement component (C) 5 and can generate autocrine C5a via formation of an intracellular C5 convertase. Further, cholesterol crystal-sensing by macrophages induces C5aR1 signaling on mitochondrial membranes, which shifts ATP production via reverse electron chain flux towards reactive oxygen species (ROS) production and anaerobic glycolysis to favor IL-1β production. Consequently, atherosclerosis-prone mice lacking macrophage-specific C5ar1 had ameliorated cardiovascular disease on a high-cholesterol diet. Conversely, inflammatory gene signatures and IL-1β produced by cells in unstable atherosclerotic plaques of patients were normalized by a specific cell-permeable C5aR1 antagonist. Deficiency of the macrophage cell autonomous C5 system also protected mice from crystal nephropathy mediated by folic acid. These data demonstrate unexpected intracellular formation of a C5 convertase and identify C5aR1 as a direct modulator of mitochondrial function and inflammatory output from myeloid cells. Together, these findings suggest that the complosome is a novel contributor to the biologic processes underlying sterile inflammation and indicate that targeting this system could be beneficial in macrophage-dependent diseases, such as atherosclerosis.
datasets.overall_design: Four atherosclerosis patients are recuited in this study. The biopsies containing atherosclerotic plaques of each patient were split into macroscopically equal pieces and treated with non-cell permeable C5aR1 antagonist PMX53 (10 μg/ml), cell permeable C5aR1 antagonist JEP1375 (10 μg/ml) or PBS for 6 hrs.

datasets.relevance_reason: 直接使用颈动脉粥样硬化斑块患者标本

evidence.relevant: 研究主体为动脉粥样硬化（carotid stenosis 的直接病因/病理连续体），12 例样本均取自患者动脉粥样硬化颈动脉斑块组织。
evidence.sequencing_type: molecule=polyA RNA 表明通过oligo-dT富集polyA+ RNA，library_strategy=RNA-Seq 高通量测序，组织提取无单细胞/空间特征，为bulk mRNA-seq。
evidence.survival_analysis: 仅4例患者，无生存时间/状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: GSM treatment字段显示PBS(对照)、PMX53和JEP1375两种C5aR1拮抗剂处理，形成药物vs对照的核心比较轴。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 所有样本均为动脉粥样硬化斑块，缺乏正常健康对照，无法做疾病vs正常差异分析
evidence.correlation: 仅4例患者且样本为体外药物处理，独立患者数<16，不满足相关性分析要求
evidence.sample_source: 斑块活检组织块切割后体外培养6h并加药处理，属ex vivo组织切片受刺激，按规则判为primary_cell。
evidence.treatment_type: PMX53和JEP1375均为C5aR1受体拮抗剂，属于靶向特定受体的小分子/肽类，符合targeted therapy定义。
evidence.pre_post_treatment: GSM中仅有体外药物处理后的单一时间点样本，无同一队列治疗前vs治疗后的采样分组字段。
evidence.response: GSM元数据中无任何按治疗反应分组（如responder/non-responder、RECIST）的字段。

datasets.title: Pro-efferocytic nanotherapies reduce vascular inflammation without inducing anemia in a large animal model of atherosclerosis
datasets._e23824: 索臻生物科技SOGEN·生信+湿实验一站式·一区顶刊课题合作·加群获取增量·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: Atherosclerosis is an inflammatory disorder responsible for cardiovascular disease. Reactivation of efferocytosis, the phagocytic removal of cells by macrophages, has emerged as a translational target for atherosclerosis. Systemic blockade of the key ‘don’t-eat-me’ molecule, CD47, triggers the engulfment of apoptotic vascular tissue and potently reduces plaque burden.  However, it also induces red blood cell clearance, leading to anemia. To overcome this, we previously developed a macrophage-specific nanotherapy loaded with a chemical inhibitor that promotes efferocytosis. Because it was found to be safe and effective in murine studies, we aimed to advance our nanoparticle into a porcine model of atherosclerosis. Here, we demonstrate that production can be scaled without impairing nanoparticle function. At an early stage of disease, we find our nanotherapy reduces apoptotic cell accumulation and inflammation in the atherosclerotic lesion. Notably, this therapy does not induce anemia, highlighting the translational potential of targeted macrophage checkpoint inhibitors.
datasets.overall_design: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of a macrophage-specific nanotherapy loaded with a chemical inhibitor of SHP-1 in a porcine model of atherosclerosis, focusing on its ability to reduce apoptotic cell accumulation and inflammation without inducing anemia.
datasets.study_design: 猪动脉粥样硬化模型颈动脉组织，纳米药物SWNT-SHP1i与载体SWNT的RNA-seq比较
datasets.relevance_reason: 研究猪动脉粥样硬化模型颈动脉的纳米疗法

evidence.relevant: 动脉粥样硬化是颈动脉狭窄的核心致病过程，本研究以猪动脉粥样硬化模型颈动脉组织为样本，直接针对该病的病理机制与治疗。
evidence.sequencing_type: total RNA起始、cDNA文库、常规RNA-Seq差异表达分析，无特定ncRNA富集证据，按规则默认mRNA-seq
evidence.survival_analysis: 动物模型(猪)，非人类患者，且无生存时间/状态字段
evidence.treatment: 样本级treatment字段显示400nM of SWNT-SHP1i(6)与400nM of SWNT(5)对照，属载活性药递送系统treated vs vehicle核心比较。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 均为动脉粥样硬化模型处理组，无独立健康对照
evidence.correlation: 动物模型样本不计入患者数，且总数11例<16
evidence.sample_source: 所有11个GSM的source均为carotid artery，取自高脂饮食+静脉给药12周后的猪颈动脉，Trizol直接提总RNA测序，未分选特定细胞类型，属体内实体组织。
evidence.pre_post_treatment: 所有样本均为猪颈动脉处理后采集，缺乏治疗前（基线）时间点，为横断面 SWNT vs SWNT-SHP1i 组间对比，非纵向前后配对。
evidence.response: GSM仅有treatment分组（SWNT-SHP1i vs SWNT对照），无responder/non-responder等疗效结局分级字段，条件②不满足
evidence.treatment_type: [audit2-reflect改判] 原值为整句推理散文，非词表token，格式污染直接定错；实质属靶向治疗，修正为targeted therapy
